criteria.reason: 明确初始化动作价值表、回报统计和 epsilon-greedy 策略。
criteria.evidence_quote: Initialize an action-value table, return statistics and an epsilon-greedy policy.

criteria.reason: 说明用当前 epsilon-greedy 策略生成完整 episode。
criteria.evidence_quote: Roll out full episodes with the current such policy.

criteria.reason: 说明从 episode 末尾向前累积折扣回报。
criteria.evidence_quote: Accumulate discounted returns backwards from the end.

criteria.reason: 要求选择 first-visit 或 every-visit 并保持一致。
criteria.evidence_quote: Decide on first-visit or every-visit treatment and use it consistently.

criteria.reason: 说明用样本均值或增量等价更新被访问状态动作对的 Q。
criteria.evidence_quote: Update observed state-action values with the sample mean or its incremental equivalent.

criteria.reason: 说明正 epsilon 保证非贪心动作有非零概率。
criteria.evidence_quote: Positive epsilon leaves a nonzero chance for nongreedy actions.

criteria.reason: 说明根据更新后的 Q 重新计算 epsilon-greedy 策略。
criteria.evidence_quote: Recompute the epsilon-greedy policy from the new Q estimates.

criteria.reason: 说明用停止预算或性能稳定性规则以及探索调度作为停止条件。
criteria.evidence_quote: Specify a stopping budget or performance-stability rule and the exploration schedule.
